skills.name: discovering-and-invoking-skills
skills.description: Discovers and invokes agent skills: the meta-skill that decides which skill or workflow applies when a session starts or a new piece of work begins. skills.name: engineering-agent-context
skills.description: Optimizes agent context setup: starting new sessions, recovering from degraded output, switching between tasks and configuring rules files and context for a project. Use this skill when: starting a new session, output quality degrades, switching tasks or configuring a project's rules files. Do NOT use this skill when: the goal is only to compress messages or prompts (use compressing-agent-messages or configuring-prompt-compression).

skills.name: interviewing-user-requirements
skills.description: Extracts what the user actually wants through a one-question-at-a-time interview until intent is about 95% clear, when a request is underspecified or the user asks to be interviewed or challenged.
